title: Detention and Tryouts
author: Elodie Eriksen
blurb: Lena Okonkwo, a scholarship student at an academy with too many secrets, is fine. Everything is fine. Obviously.. But when the teacher pairs nemesis with nemesis for a semester-long project, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must tell the truth even if it costs the friendship, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
